subject: Initial SOC2 Type II package request — audit window clarification & bridge letter draft
messages:

Cc: Tom Russo <tom.russo@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for audit window

Hi Irene,

Following up from our vendor intake call — Acme is preparing our 2026 operational audit and we'd like to request Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covering controls for the period that most closely matches our audit window (we're targeting 2025-07-01 through 2025-12-31). Can you confirm: 

- Whether Redwood has a Type II report that covers that audit period or an adjacent period (if so, please indicate exact dates).
- Whether you can provide a signed bridge letter if the covered period doesn't fully align.
- A minimal evidence manifest or list of artifacts your team typically shares (vuln scans, access reviews, KMS rotation logs, incident logs, change control artifacts).

We have external auditors who will accept SFTP, secure Drive, or DocuSign-signed bridging statements. If you have a preferred transfer mechanism and a short checklist we can follow, that would be very helpful.

Thanks — we aim to kick off evidence intake next week.

Regards,
Lara Nguyen
Senior Information Security Analyst
Acme Analytics
lara.nguyen@acme-analytics.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear ask and flagging the audit window. Quick answers up front: 

- We have a SOC 2 Type II report for the period 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31 (Type II). That overlaps your window; we'll confirm whether the auditor will accept that span or prefer a bridge letter for the July–December subset.
- We can provide a signed bridge letter to cover an interim period if needed. I am attaching a draft bridge letter and a starter evidence manifest.
- Preferred transfer: secure SFTP to your intake host, or we can place artifacts in a pre-configured shared Drive folder with expiry (we usually provide scoping details & checksums). For statements requiring signature (bridge letter), we can sign and return via DocuSign.

What I'll do next: 
1) Share the draft bridge letter and a compact evidence_manifest.csv (see attachments).
2) Outline what we can provide immediately (report PDF, system description, mapping to CC, entitlement review samples, KMS rotation log sample).
3) Coordinate with Sean for any granular logs your auditor requires (he's our intake lead for log pulls).

Attached: bridge-letter-draft.docx, evidence-manifest.csv, kms-rotation-log-sample.txt

If you confirm SFTP credentials or prefer Drive, we'll start the upload tonight (PDT).

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance

Irene / team — quick clarifying Qs from our audit desk: 

- The 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31 period looks fine on the face of it, but our scope is strictly 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31. We typically accept a bridge letter if it clearly attests that controls in the gap were in effect and no material control changes occurred.
- Please confirm whether Redwood substantiates control continuity for July–Dec 2025 (change control logs, SOC vendor management, and KMS key rotation records). Do you rotate keys quarterly? Are rotation artifacts available for the July and October 2025 cycles?
- A succinct bridge letter that references the report, audit dates, and a short statement on no material control changes should suffice for our auditors. If you could also include a signed attestation and a sample of the KMS rotation log (sanitized), that will expedite acceptance.

We can provide SFTP credentials by end of day.

Tom Russo
Senior Audit Manager, External Audit
Acme Analytics

Attachments: vendor-soc-sample-scope.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter for audit window

Tom / Lara — appreciate the precision. Below is a compact bridge letter draft (we can send to DocuSign once you confirm language):

--- BEGIN DRAFT BRIDGE LETTER ---
Redwood Inference
Head of Security & Compliance
Date: 2026-09-21

To Whom It May Concern,

This letter is provided in connection with Redwood Inference's SOC 2 Type II report issued for the period April 1, 2025 through March 31, 2026. We confirm that, to the best of our knowledge and based on our control monitoring and records, the system controls relevant to the scope of that report were in place and operating effectively for the subset period July 1, 2025 through December 31, 2025. 

Specifically, Redwood attests to the following for the July–December 2025 period: 
- No material changes were made to the control environment that would materially impact the effectiveness of the controls reported in the SOC 2 Type II.
- Key management practices (KMS rotations) were performed per policy during the period; redacted rotation logs are available on request and have been provided as a sample.
- Access reviews and change control approvals were performed on the cadence documented in the system description.

This letter is provided for the benefit of Acme Analytics and its auditors and is not intended to expand the scope of Redwood's SOC 2 report.

Sincerely,

Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
--- END DRAFT BRIDGE LETTER ---

Action items and guidance for transfer: 
- We will upload the following to the secure intake location you provide: the SOC 2 Type II PDF (full report), system description, control mapping (CC-to-evidence), evidence_manifest.csv, KMS rotation sample (kms-rotation-log-sample.txt), and a recent vulnerability scan summary.
- Please let us know which fields (if any) to redact in logs for customer-identifying data — by default we redact user identifiers and IPs but keep timestamps and request IDs to preserve chain-of-custody.
- We'll also provide hash checksums for each file (SHA256) and an index file for your intake.

Next steps: 
1) Lara/Tom confirm transfer target (SFTP endpoint or Drive folder) and whether DocuSign is preferred for the bridge letter.
2) If DocuSign OK, we'll send the draft for signature and return a signed PDF. 
3) Sean will stand by to extract any additional log slices your auditor needs.

cc: Grace — for coordination on any expedited contracting asks.

Best,
Irene
